outcome: Infant weight gain in the first 3 months
Neonatal serum zinc and vitamin D levels
cohort: Pregnant women at five referral hospitals in the Amhara region (n = 3459)
finding: This study found that GDM was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, higher infant weight gain in the first three months, increased episodes of childhood infectious diseases, and decreased neonatal serum zinc and vitamin D levels.
